recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future resource, profile, or owned page bypasses the fhir.ini ownership mechanism or renders without a responsible owner.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to add responsible Work Group information to Resources, Profiles, and possibly other owned FHIR pages; the accepted motion says the information is managed through fhir.ini.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-3727, but git history shows the requested mechanism was applied implicitly: 282fa4b71c added source/fhir.ini [workgroups] and [wg-info] sections one day after the accepted motion, 96a2d4e308 added work-group prefixes to active [profiles] entries, and later source restructuring preserved the StructureDefinition workgroup extension.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini is active build input. It has active resources, active profile entries with WG prefixes, workgroup mappings, and WG URL/name metadata. Current Patient StructureDefinition source carries structuredefinition-wg=pa. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source change was made because the current build inputs and current rendered build already satisfy the issue request.
